statement.ru: Зубная эмаль — самое твёрдое вещество в теле человека.
statement.en: Tooth enamel is the hardest substance in the human body.

why: Enamel is the hardest substance in the human body (96% mineral).

statement.ru: Самая большая мышца человека — бицепс.
statement.en: The biggest muscle in the human body is the biceps.

why: The largest single muscle is the gluteus maximus, the buttock muscle.

statement.ru: У мужчин на одно ребро меньше, чем у женщин.
statement.en: Men have one rib fewer than women.

why: A Bible-based myth refuted by Vesalius in 1543: both sexes have 12 pairs.

statement.ru: Картинка на сетчатке глаза перевёрнута вверх ногами.
statement.en: The image on the retina of the eye is upside down.

why: The lens projects an inverted image on the retina; the brain sees it upright.

statement.ru: Глазное яблоко у новорождённого уже взрослого размера.
statement.en: A newborn's eyeball is already full adult size.

why: The eye grows from about 16-17 mm at birth to about 24 mm, full size by age 12.

statement.ru: Один подросток однажды не спал 11 дней подряд.
statement.en: A teenager once stayed awake for 11 days in a row.

why: Randy Gardner, 17, stayed awake 264 hours (11 days) in 1963-64.

statement.ru: Разбудить лунатика — значит навредить его здоровью.
statement.en: Waking a sleepwalker harms their health.

why: Waking a sleepwalker does not harm them; they may just be confused for a moment.

statement.ru: Больше половины костей человека — в кистях и стопах.
statement.en: More than half of a person's bones are in the hands and feet.

why: 27 bones per hand and 26 per foot (Foot article) make 106 of the adult's 206.

statement.ru: Зубы — это кости.
statement.en: Teeth are bones.

why: Teeth are not made of bone but of enamel, dentin and other tissues.

statement.ru: Кровь вырабатывается внутри костей.
statement.en: Blood is produced inside the bones.

why: Bone marrow is the main site of blood cell production: about 500 billion cells a day.

statement.ru: Микробов в теле в десять раз больше, чем собственных клеток.
statement.en: There are ten times more microbes in the body than its own cells.

why: The 10:1 figure is a 1972 guess; current estimates put the ratio near 1:1.

statement.ru: Ногти сделаны из того же вещества, что и рог носорога.
statement.en: Fingernails are made of the same stuff as a rhino's horn.

why: Rhino horns are keratin, the same material as hair and fingernails.

statement.ru: Ушная сера — это просто грязь в ушах.
statement.en: Earwax is just dirt in your ears.

why: Earwax is a secretion that protects, cleans and lubricates the ear canal.

statement.ru: Чихнуть с открытыми глазами невозможно.
statement.en: It is impossible to sneeze with your eyes open.

why: The eyes close by reflex, but the claim that you cannot sneeze with eyes open is inaccurate.

statement.ru: В желудке человека — настоящая соляная кислота.
statement.en: The human stomach contains real hydrochloric acid.

why: Stomach acid is hydrochloric acid, pH 1 to 3.

statement.ru: Мозг Эйнштейна был заметно тяжелее обычного.
statement.en: Einstein's brain was noticeably heavier than usual.

why: It weighed 1230 g, within (low end of) the normal 1.2-1.4 kg range.

statement.ru: Глотая, человек на мгновение перестаёт дышать.
statement.en: When you swallow, you stop breathing for a moment.

why: Swallowing apnea: breathing is inhibited during each swallow.

statement.ru: Люди делятся на «левополушарных» логиков и «правополушарных» творцов.
statement.en: People divide into 'left-brained' logical and 'right-brained' creative types.

why: Pop-psychology myth: brain scans show no left- or right-brain dominant people.

statement.ru: Кадык есть и у женщин.
statement.en: Women have an Adam's apple too.

why: Women have the same laryngeal prominence; it is smaller and less visible.

statement.ru: Нормальная температура тела — ровно 36,6 °C.
statement.en: Normal body temperature is exactly 36.6 °C.

why: Normal is a range (about 36.5-37.5 °C) and varies with person and time of day.

statement.ru: Взрослый в покое делает больше десяти тысяч вдохов в сутки.
statement.en: An adult at rest takes more than ten thousand breaths a day.

why: A resting adult breathes 12-15 times a minute: about 17,000-21,600 breaths a day.

statement.ru: Дальтонизм у женщин встречается гораздо чаще, чем у мужчин.
statement.en: Colour blindness is much more common in women than in men.

why: Red-green colour blindness: about 8% of men, 0.5% of women.

statement.ru: Есть звук, который слышат подростки, но не слышат взрослые.
statement.en: There is a sound that teenagers can hear but adults can't.

why: The Mosquito device plays about 17.4 kHz, generally heard only by young people.

statement.ru: Когда человеку снятся самые яркие сны, его мышцы почти полностью отключаются.
statement.en: During a person's most vivid dreams, their muscles almost completely switch off.

why: In REM sleep, when vivid dreams happen, the body loses muscle tone (REM atonia) and is paralysed.

statement.ru: Из всех приматов подбородок есть только у человека.
statement.en: Of all the primates, only humans have a chin.

why: Humans are the only species among primates with a chin.

statement.ru: В выдыхаемом воздухе кислорода больше, чем углекислого газа.
statement.en: Exhaled air holds more oxygen than carbon dioxide.

why: Exhaled air is about 14-16% oxygen and only 4-5% carbon dioxide.

statement.ru: Один сон длится всего несколько секунд.
statement.en: A single dream lasts only a few seconds.

why: Each dream lasts around 5 to 20 minutes; people dream over two hours a night.

statement.ru: Новорождённый видит так же чётко, как взрослый.
statement.en: A newborn baby sees as sharply as an adult.

why: A newborn's acuity is about 20/800 to 20/200; adult level comes around six months.

statement.ru: Обычно одна ноздря дышит лучше другой, и они сменяют друг друга.
statement.en: Usually one nostril breathes better than the other, and they take turns.

why: The nasal cycle: one side partly congests, then they swap over hours.

statement.ru: У ребёнка может быть группа крови, которой нет ни у мамы, ни у папы.
statement.en: A child can have a blood group that neither mum nor dad has.

why: An A parent and a B parent can have an AB or an O child.

statement.ru: Плавно вести взглядом по пустой стене не выйдет — глаза прыгают рывками.
statement.en: You can't sweep your gaze smoothly across a blank wall: your eyes jump in jerks.

why: Most people cannot do smooth pursuit without a moving target; the eyes make saccades.

statement.ru: Желудок находится внизу живота, под пупком.
statement.en: The stomach sits low in the belly, below the navel.

why: The stomach is in the upper left part of the abdomen, just under the diaphragm.

statement.ru: У рыжих волос на голове больше, чем у блондинов.
statement.en: Redheads have more hairs on their head than blondes.

why: Average: blondes about 150,000 hairs, redheads about 90,000.

statement.ru: Можно зевнуть, просто прочитав о зевоте.
statement.en: You can yawn just from reading about yawning.

why: Reading or thinking about yawning can make a person yawn.

statement.ru: Самый частый цвет волос на Земле — светлый.
statement.en: The most common hair colour on Earth is blond.

why: Black is the most common; brown is second.

statement.ru: Волос, который мы видим над кожей, — уже мёртвый.
statement.en: The hair we see above the skin is already dead.

why: The visible hair shaft is keratinized dead cells; only the follicle is alive.

statement.ru: Больше всего гормона роста выделяется во сне.
statement.en: Most growth hormone is released during sleep.

why: The largest, most predictable GH peak comes about an hour after falling asleep.

statement.ru: Сердце взрослого человека — размером с футбольный мяч.
statement.en: An adult's heart is the size of a football.

why: The heart is about the size of a closed fist.

statement.ru: Яйцеклетку человека можно разглядеть без микроскопа.
statement.en: A human egg cell can be seen without a microscope.

why: The ovum, about 0.12 mm, is typically visible to the naked eye.

statement.ru: Нервные сигналы бегут по телу со скоростью света.
statement.en: Nerve signals travel through the body at the speed of light.

why: The fastest go about 120 m/s (432 km/h), far below light speed.

statement.ru: Худея, человек выдыхает бóльшую часть потерянного жира.
statement.en: When you lose weight, you breathe out most of the lost fat.

why: Meerman and Brown (BMJ 2014): about 84% of lost fat leaves as exhaled CO2.

statement.ru: В теле взрослого человека около 20 литров крови.
statement.en: An adult's body holds about 20 litres of blood.

why: Blood volume is about 65-70 ml per kg: about 5 litres for a 70 kg adult.

statement.ru: Чтобы чихнуть, спящему человеку сначала придётся проснуться.
statement.en: To sneeze, a sleeping person first has to wake up.

why: Sneezing cannot occur during sleep (REM atonia); a person wakes up to sneeze.

statement.ru: Левое полушарие мозга управляет левой рукой.
statement.en: The left half of the brain controls the left hand.

why: The forebrain controls mostly the opposite (contralateral) side of the body.

statement.ru: Коленные чашечки у малышей ещё из хряща, а не из кости.
statement.en: Toddlers' kneecaps are still cartilage, not bone.

why: The patella ossifies at about 2 to 6 years; before that it is cartilage.

statement.ru: Запах пота создают бактерии на коже.
statement.en: The smell of sweat is made by bacteria on the skin.

why: Body odour mainly comes from skin bacteria breaking down sweat.

statement.ru: У человека ровно пять чувств.
statement.en: Humans have exactly five senses.

why: Humans have more than the five usual senses (balance, temperature, pain, body position...); counts range from 5 to over 20.

statement.ru: За равновесие тела отвечает внутреннее ухо.
statement.en: The inner ear is in charge of the body's balance.

why: The vestibular system in the inner ear senses balance and head motion.

statement.ru: Кровь красная из-за меди.
statement.en: Blood is red because of copper.

why: Red blood comes from haemoglobin, an iron-containing protein; copper-based blood is blue (octopus).

statement.ru: Каждый день у здорового человека выпадает около тысячи волос.
statement.en: A healthy person loses about a thousand hairs every day.

why: A normal scalp sheds 50-100 hairs a day, ten times fewer.
